appName: Sniper Shadow Strike: VR Shooting Game
displayName: Sniper Shadow Strike: VR Shooting Game
display_name: Sniper Shadow Strike: VR Shooting Game
display_long_description:
Take your shooting skills to the next level in an immersive VR FPS sniper shooter and action-packed gun game. Step into the role of an elite sniper and experience realistic first-person shooting where precision, timing, and tactical decisions truly matter.

Unlock and master 6 sniper rifles, each with unique stats and weapon skins, delivering a true sniper shooter and gun game experience. Customize your elite sniper with masks, paints, and outfits to create your own identity and preferred playstyle.

Progress through Career missions, test your skills with timed challenges, and survive intense encounters in zombie survival scenarios. Each mode helps improve your accuracy, reflexes, and control in varied shooting situations.

Experience smooth and responsive first-person shooting with immersive VR controls. Practice tactical shooting, improve your aim, and react quickly in dynamic combat while upgrading your gear and refining your strategy.

Explore detailed environments built for VR FPS gameplay, adding depth and immersion to every mission. Whether engaging targets from long range or reacting under pressure, every moment challenges your skills and decision-making.

Train, improve your precision, and evolve your playstyle as you work toward becoming an elite sniper. With engaging gameplay and multiple modes, this VR sniper shooter offers strong replayability and a complete VR shooting experience.

Are you ready to take the shot? Lock, load, and strike from the shadows.
